title: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Automation for Pharmaceutical Engineering
session_title: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Automation for Pharmaceutical Engineering
abstract: The session will elaborate on the ways that AI/ML and automation can be used in the Pharmaceutical R&D workflow. The attendees will learn the important elements of the development of medicines and how AI/ML is changing the landscape of Pharma R&D Specific examples will focus on the use of ML in process optimization and automation for quality by control
